$schema_note: Canonical machine-readable severity ranking for the CV Optimizer skill. Mirrors the Severity Prioritization section of references/rewriting-guidelines.md - keep both in sync if either changes. Used by scripts/improve_cv.py to build a priority queue when no cv-reviewer output is supplied.

severity_levels.meaning: ATS-blocking structural issue; likely causes outright rejection before a human ever reads the resume
Significantly weakens recruiter/hiring-manager impression or interview odds
Noticeable but not disqualifying; worth fixing in the same pass
Polish-level; fix if time/space allows, never worth blocking on

issue_types.note: Image-based/scanned PDF with no extractable text - cannot be fixed by rewriting alone; ask for a text-based export.
Contact info missing from the main body or undetectable near the top of the document.
No Experience, Education, or Skills section detected.
Bullets describe duties without outcomes, or use weak verbs/phrases throughout.
Summary/objective is absent or too generic to differentiate the candidate.
Header uses non-standard wording that may not parse as its intended section.
Multiple date formats used across entries.
Job description or target role emphasizes terms genuinely absent from the resume.
Same opening verb used 3+ times across bullets.
Multiple bullet character styles used in the document.
Uneven blank-line spacing between entries or sections.
Isolated typos or punctuation inconsistencies not affecting overall clarity.
